newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ajinomoto plans to market diabetes drug in 1999/00.
newsitem.headline: Ajinomoto plans to market diabetes drug in 1999/00.

text.p: Ajinomoto Co Inc said on Friday that it plans to market a new diabetes drug in Japan in the 1999/2000 business year, which begins on April 1, 1999.
The drug is currently being jointly developed with Yamanouchi Pharmaceutical Co Ltd in Japan, an Ajinomoto spokesman said.
The drug will also be developed and marketed in the U.S. and European markets by Swiss drug maker Novartis AG, he said.
Ajinomoto aims to double its annual sales in the pharmaceutical sector to 50 billion yen within the next five years, the spokesman said.
The company's sales in the pharmaceutical sector reached 25 billion yen in fiscal 1996/97, which ended on March 31.
